verdict.pick: Amazon Basics 13.2‑Gallon Rectangle Soft‑Close Trash Can
verdict.line: Ideal for most households that want a quiet, odor‑blocking bin without spending a lot. It uses a soft‑close lid and a 13‑gallon capacity to keep smells sealed, and it costs about half of premium competitors. The catch is it lacks a foot pedal for hands‑free operation.
